This hot pot place features a sleek, upscale, and modern interior. The individual hot pot burner setup makes the dining experience feel hygienic, comfortable, and well-suited for both small groups and couples.

Food & Taste:
The ingredient quality is consistently top-notch. From their premium thinly sliced meats and fresh seafood to the rich broths and the incredible DIY dipping sauce bar, everything tastes exceptional and satisfying.

Service:
Polite, attentive, and very professional. The waitstaff are prompt with replenishing broths, clearing plates, and helping you navigate the menu.
My go-to late-night spot!
Came to The Dolar Shop with a party of 4, and we had a good time enjoying rounds of hot pot. They’ve got a good selection of meats and vegetables to order, and a number of snacks as well

Go get their $49.99pp AYCE hotpot deal after 9.30pm! We came around 9.15pm and waited 15 minutes for a table.

Each person gets a personal hotpot — I picked the Chef’s Creamy Pork Broth & Tomato broth (they were both yum but I wished the pork broth had more flavor to it).

The wagyu was a definite standout for the meats — it tasted amazing and had a nice texture. I loved that there were Chinese fried foods and desserts on the sides because I don’t see that often even in Chinese hotpot restaurants. The server stopped by a couple of times and it lowkey felt like she was trying to rush us but it was alright.

Was it the best hotpot I’ve ever tried? Not exactly. But it was delicious and we had the time of our lives :)
I love this place so much.

Went here recently and both the food and service were great — but what really stood out was how one of the staff,Feni handled a chaotic moment like an angel.
I went to lunch time and it’s hotpot spot with families and kids around, not exactly a late-night bar — yet some nearby diners were being loud enough (F-bombs every other sentence, non-stop). It clearly bothered other guests, and one of them asked to be reseated. Since I was pretty much done eating anyway, I just gave the server a little “eh, it’s fine” look — and somehow that set the reseated guest off, who turned around and aggressively started demanding to know what I was saying about her. Total mystery to me, but it's okay! Things happen.
Through all of it, Feni stayed completely calm, polite, and diplomatic to me and smoothed the whole thing over. Genuinely impressive. She handled it like an absolute pro. Honestly, this would’ve been a completely different experience without her.
Respect to her and the whole team！！and not to mention, great food!! Will definitely be back.

Came here late on a Saturday night for the all you can eat option. If you're a night owl with madddd munchies like me then you should totally check this place out! It's a tad pricey but the value is really worth it!

The vibe was great, even late into the night, and the staff were extremely friendly and helpful. For the late night ayce option you order your broths and meats on an iPad / tablet, and then you go to the buffet tables where you can choose from a variety of other ingredients to cook in the broth as well as sides and sauces. They had a nice selection of ingredients, including meats, seafood, fungi, vegetables, and noodles. I was very satisfied with the options! Although I did find myself wanting another kind of noodle or two.

I ended up going for both the spicy broth and the creamy pork broth, and was satisfied with both. Both broths were rich, smooth, and aromatic with the spicy one being my preferred of the two because of its extra zing. As for the meats, I ended up going for the ribeye, the lamb shoulder, and the pork belly. The quality of the meats was amazing! All three meats were sliced thinly and elegantly, allowing them to cook after just seconds in the broth. The ribeye was my favorite of the three. It was so tender it melted in my mouth! The lamb shoulder packed a punch flavor wise, standing up to the flavors of the broth and the sauce. The pork belly was also good, rich and mild with a nice balance of lean and fat. I ended up ordering the ribeye and the lamb again because I liked them so much! As for the other ingredients I tried the whole shrimp, napa cabbage, lotus and lotus root, soft tofu, crystal noodles, mung bean noodles, beef balls, beef tripe, cuttlefish, shiitake mushrooms, wood ear mushrooms, enoki mushrooms, bamboo shoots, seaweed knots, bean curd, fish roe balls, quail eggs, sausage, and kimchi. I'd say my favorites of the ingredients were the beef balls, the shrimp (if you're willing to peel them), the fish roe balls, the enoki mushrooms, the bean curd, the mung bean noodles, and the quail eggs. Everything was good though to be honest! Apparently they have soft serve ice cream as dessert too which I'll totally try next time.

I would definitely recommend coming here late night for the all you can eat option, the food is high quality and the service is awesome. Hopefully I'll get a chance to return!

If you’re looking for a premium late-night feast in Manhattan, The Dolar Shop is the spot! 🍲✨ I came here for their late-night all-you-can-eat hot pot ($45.99 per person, every day 9:30PM–12AM) and it was incredible.

The quality of the meats really stood out—tender beef short plate, juicy chicken thigh, lamb flap, and pork belly, all sliced fresh and perfect for hot pot. On top of that, there are over 50 extras to choose from—seafood, veggies, noodles, tofu, and even desserts. Everything was fresh and kept coming nonstop.

The vibe is modern, sleek, and fun—perfect for groups of friends or anyone who gets hungry after hours. Service was attentive and quick, which made the whole experience even better.

Honestly, $45.99 for premium all-you-can-eat hot pot in Manhattan feels like such a steal. I’ll definitely be back whenever those late-night cravings hit!

I've been to Dolar Hot Pot near Astor Place a couple times recently and was really impressed. First off, the place is super clean and modern. Everything feels fresh and well-kept, from the tables to the ingredient bar. I liked that everyone gets their own individual hot pot, which made the whole experience feel more relaxed and personal, especially if you’re with people who have different tastes.

All the ingredients were really fresh - especially the vegetables and sliced meats. The fruit and dessert bar is super nice and nostalgic as well (a lot of authentic Asian flavors and options), and at the end they brought over free ice cream, which was a great way to finish the meal.

The staff was lovely. Super attentive, checked in at just the right times, and made sure everything was going smoothly.

The only thing I felt was missing was crab. They’ve got a strong seafood selection overall, but adding crab would really round it out.

Overall, I had a great time. The food was fresh, the space was nice, and the service was great. I’d definitely go back.

A steal for the variety and quantity available during their AYCE hot pot hours. Starting at 9:30 PM everyday, you can get all you can eat hot pot for two hours. What makes The Dolar Shop especially unique and better bang-for-your-buck is their seafood, carb, and dessert bar. So in addition to the usual meats and vegetables, you can have a wide range of variety with your meal.

From the menu, I opted for the half spicy half creamy broth, lamb shoulder, chuck, ribeye, and flat iron beef. The meats arrived in good portions and staff came frequently so you could re-order without a huge lag in between. However, I was slightly disappointed with the broths, as both tasted a bit old. I'm not sure if this was a one-off, as my friends didn't have the same experience on other occasions.

At the food bars where you could grab items yourself, I stocked up on crab sticks, shrimp, chinese donuts, tofu skins, fried tofu, egg noodles, and ice jelly. The seafood did not have a fishy smell at all and paired well with the spicy broth. I also loved the chinese donuts, which were freshly made on a frequent basis and even better when topped with the condensed milk. The DIY ice jelly was a fun and refreshing way to end the night after filling up on spicy, fried, and savory foods.

Overall, I'd say this is the best AYCE hotpot deal in Manhattan. While the hours are late, I think it makes it fun for a pre-game or post-game with friends. For more food reviews, check out @chloenicholle on ig.

Their sauce is amazing, and the quality of meat is quite awesome. Recommend the ribeye and then rotate with some leaner cuts so that you don’t get sick from the richness too quickly.

Their fried buns with condensed milk is a great way to close the meal :)
Love this place so much. Best broth I’ve ever had. The tomato broth, that way you can add spice to it. I r highly recommend and will be back over and over again.

First time at a hot pot that wasn't all you can eat but honestly, this place was amazing. It was on the pricer side but good quality ingredients and they did have unlimited noodles (my fave was udon), dessert and apps for you to choose from. It ended up being more than enough food by itself. I really enjoyed the wagyu and the lamb. The staff was attentive and helpful, everything was fresh and the broth was so flavorful. I would recommend waiting for the $46 AYCE starting at 9:30pm. I also recommend you make reservations for this place. It was packed when we got there at 7pm. You can avoid the 3% credit card fee if you bring cash or use debit.

First, the front doors are heavy. Pull HARD, they’re not locked.

Walked in on a weekday around 6pm without a reservation. Place filled up though.  Good looking interior while not being super high end, so you can get by dressing casually. Works for families and dates.

Service was slow, and I suspected the kitchen, probably the meat cutting person/team. The customer-facing service team was good, quick to seat us, answer questions, good English, refilled the broths, etc. But the soups were boiling and the drinks were melting while our impatience and hunger grew as the meats were missing. The second round of ordering resulted in the same lengthy wait. This was the weakest part of the dining experience.

The strongest part was definitely the food quality. For a party of two, we ordered chef’s creamy pork broth, silky spicy broth, splurged on A5 Miyazaki Wagyu and Grand Cru Wagyu thick cut, beef short (USDA PRIME), lettuce, a choy, and rice. We could tell the difference in quality of the meats, but honestly, what really shone was the FLAVOR. My preference = the Chinese broths beat Korean and Japanese hot pot/shabu shabu every time. The house-made dipping sauce that a staff makes right in front of you is not too salty or sweet or tangy; it’s well-rounded and doesn’t overpower the meats and vegetables. That sauce is so good that I finished off the lettuce by eating it with that sauce.

Because the flavor is so good, I think that if I were a local I would be totally fine with ordering the cheapest cuts of meat. Furthermore, best bang for buck would be the late night $45 all you can eat that runs from 9:30pm to midnight.

We tried two cocktails. The Crush Grape Gummy was okay, I personally wouldn’t order again. The Tender Melody was a winner, but maybe that’s because we love lychee. We ended with vanilla ice cream cones, which were also good. I particularly enjoyed its soothing effect on my tongue after the spicy broth. For the spicy lovers, you can order the broth next level spicy by specifying Szechuan.

Would we come back? Yes, but with the hope that the kitchen was just having an off day (maybe they were short staffed). If they’re slow again, we’d probably find another hot pot place to try (there are plenty).

This place was a BLAST!!! The vibe inside was so nice and the tables were great. They accommodate larger groups which was perfect!! They had a bunch of “sets” which you could get that was pretty perfect. Comes with an app, a platter of your meat of choice, various veggies, noodles, and UNLIMITED SOFT SERVE!!!

The hot pot was great, I loved that everyone gets their own personal small pot! As opposed to other places where the table has one large pot and you have to have a designated cooker and you lose track of whats going in lol. Here everyone got to choose their own items and their own broth flavors. I got the smooth pork broth which was very well flavored and creamy, as well as the spicy broth which had a nice amount of heat to it.

Starting with the app, I chose the cucumber salad and it was pretty tasty! Sweet, salty, refreshing, fun to eat.

For the meat I chose the flat iron beef, idk why this one was calling to me but it was really good. It cooked so quick like about 10-15 seconds in the broth.

I chose the deluxe veggie platter for my sides and I’m so glad I did because it came with PUMPKIN and POTATOES!!! I put the potatoes in right at the start so that theyd cook about halfway into my meal. The pumpkin was amazinggggg so genius to have that in hot pot. The rest of the veggies were standard but really nice to have.

For the noodles I chose the hand pulled noodles and they were really nice too. Very very long so I recommend ripping them in half before you put them in to cook because fishing them out was so difficult, but well worth it because they soak up the broth really well.

They also had a sauce bar to make your own sauces. They premade us one that was pretty good but i’m all about that sesame and garlic sauce so I went and made that and it was so good.

The sauce bar also had a bunch of other goodies like candies and little panda marshmallows which was perfect for… THE UNLIMITED SOFT SERVE!!!  And it was my FAVORITE kind of soft serve like the one that is a bit watery and icey but still vanilla and delish. Wowww i could eat gallons of that.

What a GREAT place I had so much fun here!!! I love it I love it I love it I love it I love it I love it I looooove ittttt
Thank you Alex and Alex
My go to hotpot place, been going here for many years. Super delicious highly recommend!!

If you're craving premium hot pot with top-tier service, The Dolar Shop in East Village is the place to be. Their limited-time Lunch and Dinner Spring Set Menu is a steal, offering a full feast of appetizer, protein, broth, farm-fresh platter, starch, and dessert. Pair your choice of protein with different flavor broths. The Dolar Shop’s sauce bar is packed with endless options to customize every bite. Beyond the food, the spotless, modern space and super-friendly staff make dining here an absolute joy. Whether you're a hot pot pro or a first-timer, The Dolar Shop delivers.

Their dessert bar is basically a build-your-own Meet Fresh! And the “yogurt balls” are like popping bubbles filled with yakult- do NOT miss these; they’re SO GOOD!!

In terms of hot pot- it’s solid. I’d say their menu is very meat focused though (as it costs the same amount to get a meat special as a vegetarian special). But the quality of ingredients is very good- veggies are fresh, sauce station is clean.

Above average hot pot in terms of raw ingredients’ quality; but compared to the dolar shop on the west coast, there’s a lack of competition in Manhattan… variety of appetizers is a bit disappointing:$

The broth and ingredients here taste fresh and healthier than other hot pot places. Love the truffle mushroom broth! Definitely on the pricier side, but I end up paying the same bill as AYCE places after getting moderately full. Music is sometimes too loud though.
Jason was the best

Probably the best hotpot I’ve had in NYC! I really liked all the free appetizers that came with the hotpot (peanuts, kimchi, seaweed) and the broth was also stellar. Each of the cuts of chicken were super tasty. Super nice vibe in the restaurant as well: I liked all the music they played and the service was on point throughout the meal. Complementary ice cream at the end of the meal was a nice touch!
Best hot pot in Manhattan. You get ur own pot and comprehensive dessert

Too crowded, too loud, too expensive,  too small.  I miss a lot flushing location, they way they worked was so much better. I hated that the whole night a stranger was all the time hitting my arm cause we didn't have enough space or his leg hitting mine... Food is not bad but... 6 pieces of small eggs 12$..? Idk. Never gonna go back
Yum! The broths are incredible. Overall pricey but the quality is there.
Amazing food ! Amazing service people ! Amazing environment . Max stars all around !!!

The AYCE hotpot is the best I have ever tried hands down!! The quality of the meats and ingredients is phenomenal and the staff is very attentive and knowledgeable. The soup bases are also extremely flavorful. The dessert bar is so good also. So worth your money!
I’d definitely come back. Very good experience.

Ein einzigartiges Erlebnis, sein Essen am Tisch mittels einer ausgewählten Suppe zuzubereiten. Im Vorfeld kann man sich über ein Tablett die Suppe sowie Zutaten auswählen die dann zu deinem Tisch gebracht werden. Es ist wirklich sehr lecker. Je nachdem wie viele Gäste in dem Restaurant sind, kann es schon etwas lauter sein, dass eine gemütliche Atmosphäre verhindert

I wish the AYCE special was available all day or at least during earlier hours, rather than just late evenings. However, the dessert section is a great addition! The quality of the meats was excellent, and the service was great as well!

My group of 4 had a good experience at Dolar Shop. Our first time here. One of the burners was not working at all for my boyfriend but once brought to the attention of the restaurant, they replaced it and also gave a complimentary beef which was nice. I think the ambiance was good for a group catching up and I didn't feel rushed. The complimentary ice cream is a fun end to the dining experience. I'd return!

Was seated pretty quickly for a group a 4 on a Sunday late afternoon without a reservation. Broth was great, not too salty. Quite spicy. Sauce bar is great. Pricey, but understandable for the quality of the meat. Easy to order on tablets.

Took my goddaughter here last night and we had a great time. The staffs were so friendly and welcoming. 
The only small disappointment was the free appetizer.

the broth is super good especially the tomato one. Creamy tomato broth!! i also think the amount of food they give you is a LOT and i was definitely full even when i wasn't completely finished. Service was very attentive and the place was very clean. I would recommend if you're craving some hot pot for sure

Is my first time ever trying hot pot and I've been thinking about it ever since! Never really wanted to experience something like this because I never understood, Why am I paying to put my own food? But I learned it's all about the experience! Was immediately seated, and the waiter came and explained the whole process in the different items that you can order. And from there I ended up just locking in and having a blast. Eating great quality food and enjoy enjoying that atmosphere. The service ended with a nice treat of vanilla custard. And just based off that I'll be back.

The hotpot was absolutely delicious! The service was great, and the food was fresh and flavorful. I also loved the sauce--it was so yummy and went perfectly with everything. And the dessert was the perfect way to finish the meal!
Employees are so nice. Food is always so good and great experience. My friends and I come monthly!!

We have The Dolar Shop in Washington and it's easily the best hot pot around. I've always been intrigued by the AYCE option offered here if the quality is just as good. We had the Five Boroughs Special for the World Cup and while tasty, the quality is slightly more average, similar to our other premium hot pots but not our expected The Dolar Shop level. Imagine AYCE is similar, so still pretty premium but with some room to be higher quality.

Service is great, as expected for The Dolar Shop. Bathroom (washroom, restroom as search terms) available but requires going down stairs to access. Hot food was not available during our visit but there are three or four serving trays with items. Sauce bar includes some tasty fruit and the classic ice jelly dessert.

would like to start off saying service was fantastic and our server was super attentive, but the rating will be solely on the food. 

I am from the Bay Area with the best Chinese hot pot imo so I have very high standards. 

Sauce bar: was lacking immensely! I was actually a bit surprised, however they have all the basic ingredients you need to make ur sauce so that's good. 

Soup: I got creamy tomato and the chefs special (I think some sort of tonkatsu) and it was lacking flavor as well. I was missing the punch I usually get from hot pot, had to add a lot of additional ingredients to make sure the soup was to my liking.

Meat: ok the meat plates here are bigger than I expected! Meat quality is pretty good and they are decently sized, thickness wise. We got lamb and beef and all were pretty good. 

They have ice cream too and bathroom is downstairs btw. 

Overall it's not bad and it's a decent hot pot place but not my favorite where I'd come back.

This hot pot place has been on my list for a while especially since I outgrown (more like I can no longer handle AYCE hot pot). My friend and I came here for lunch on Sunday - would recommend making a reservation online but they had a bunch of open spots. They do have AYCE here after 9:30 pm but for the rest of us - they do have individual pots and you can pick either the sets (which include broth, one meat and veggies plus noodles). All the sets were pretty solid and we were really full from ordering the sets. My friend got the pork belly and I got the Beef Short plate and both were good quality meats and the veggies had a good variety and was fresh. You can make your own sauces and they even have a dessert station with jellies, taro balls and toppings. At the end of the meal they ask if we wanted ice cream which was solid. Overall - good vibes and very clean; I left with my hair not smelling like hot pot which is always a plus. We were pretty full and it came out to be around $46 per person including tip and tax which I did not think was bad in my books. Highly recommend checking this place out!

Vibe/ambiance: clean and comfortable seating
Service: standard, but a plate a meat we ordered never came
Reservation: recommended 

Items ordered:
Hotpot was solid and ingredients were fresh
After 9pm: ayce

I loveeee Dolar shop! That being said this location is no where near the Seattle location. It is smaller, the service is not as great, the sauce bar, the snack bar is lacking in comparison, and the space is just much smaller. 
We went during restaurant week and the price for food ratio was a bit of a scam compared to normal deluxe package! I still love Dolar shop and will come back even to this location.
I recommend requesting the Dolar shop special sauce and coming in hungry
Great ambiance and fresh selection. Service is always great and the experience is worth the late night visit.

The remaining Dolar Shop (the one in Flushing closed) - love the sauce and fruit bar along with the little appetizers and they have an AYCE after 9pm on weekdays.

The weekdays lunch have lunch specials - a tray of meat and veggies. This is your own little pot and you can craft your own sauce at the sauce bar. I particularly like their meat sauce and the jelly w/ toppings.

They have seating for up to 14 at a big long table, though they need to have some heads up if you want to do that. They also can do smaller parties via reservation normally (less than 10 ppl).

A la carte where you order off an ipad, but everyone gets their own pot!! There's a pretty big variety of ingredients to choose from and a sauce bar, dessert bar, and even a little candy station which you dont see often at hot pot. I did find it a lil pricey, but the quality of the ingredients equate to the prices. Pretty big space, but make sure to have a resy bc it was so packed and busy on a weekday. Staff were very attentive and kind, id def come back again:)

I have walked by this restaurant quite a few times. When my little said he wanted ramen I decided to check it out. I was super intrigued about the fact that they cater to those who only eat Halal. While I am Muslim, I am not so rigid with Halal but it was awesome to have that option. I have never been to a hotplate restaurant. I didn't have a reservation but they were able to get me in pretty quickly. The staff was attentive and showed me the ropes. They had fresh fruit juices. The ambiance was comfortable for dining. Not to loud. My little enjoyed himself. Food was tasty.
This place is fun and the food is fresh and delicious. Super fun for my family, but also looks like a fun date place.

The food I got was a combo deal with wagyu meat and it was good. The wagyu was high quality, and I enjoyed the spicy broth as well. The sauce station was huge, and I accidentally put too many peppers in my sauce so it ended up being really spicy lol.

Service was ok. Our server stopped by only a few times and it was short and sweet. The ambiance was really clean, and there was a small wait which wasn't too bad.
I love Dolar Shop! I have been going here for years now. The broths are delicious, the service is phenomenal, and the inside is very modern and bright!

Busy on a Saturday evening but for good reason - excellent hotpot! 

We had a reservation through Yelp but it might've just been that thing where it holds a place in line for you? We arrived on-time and waited another maybe 5 mins for our table. No biggie. 

I really love that each person gets their own soup pot. Makes it much easier when you've got a variety of spice levels to deal with. Everything we got was fresh and good quality. 

The restaurant space itself is very nice and modern feeling. Pretty large with a variety of table spaces and sizes. Everyone we interacted with was friendly. 

Service was good and they were pretty busy but it was only felt in my drink being  delayed from the bar (placed before we ordered any food but showed up only after food arrived. Husband's beer arrived super fast though fwiw)

My only gripe is the menu on the iPad thing - there are no descriptions of anything (including cocktails). We kept trying to click stuff on the iPad to see the description, but it was adding it to the cart. It would be great if there were descriptions, so you could see more detail about each item before you order (at least for the cocktails).

We ate à la carte but the AYCE was starting while we were there and it looked pretty dope. Lots of good stuff laid out in large qty. 

All in all we will probably add this to our hotpot restaurant list and will return again.

Definitely on the pricier side, but really good quality! The broths were delicious, the ingredients are pretty varied and super fresh, literally sitting on ice that gets replenished often, and it's so convenient to just order the meats off a tablet at the table. I'm also a big fan of the after meal soft serve they give you.

Repeated visits to their AYCE have probably taken at least a month off my lifespan.

The orders for meat pretty much always go through. The Szechuan-spice level spicy broth has a really strong tallow flavor which I love. The small dessert bar and ice cream at the end are great.

This is a more premium version of your typical hot pot - you can tell in the quality of the meats (and also the bill lol). It's also an individual pot so you don't have to share your broth. It's a more limited menu though so you might not find every ingredient you're looking for. Overall I'd recommend it!

Amazing hot pot experience. You pick your own broth base and then choice of meats + veggies. The broth didn't take that long to heat and everything came out so quickly. When we saw the topping bar we were flabbergasted... unlimited delicious toppings for sauces & little dessert-y things like lychee bubbles and even fruit. It was heavenly.  So nice to have an opportunity to try some new flavors. Place was large and clean and all I could think about was how I wanted to bring all my friends there.

It's pricy, but you can taste the quality of the meats and other ingredients. The lamb and beef cuts are so tender and marinated well that I don't even add any of the other sauces. The make a house sauce at the table, but the self-serve sauce bar has a bunch of the classic sauces, along with some fun snacks (kimchi, seaweed, prawn chips, taro balls, etc.) I really liked the chewy mochi texture of the taro balls. They all serve some complimentary chicken portions. The fish tofu, Napa cabbage, udon noodles, and Wagyu scallion pancake were all great as well. I'm also obsessed with the complimentary soft serve at the end--I don't normally like soft serve, but the milkiness of this one and the cone really hits the spot!

I like how everyone gets their own small pot and can choose their individual broth.

We walked in for three people at 6:15 on a Saturday (after calling ahead), but it was pretty busy by the time we left.

Hot pot dinner with friends is just what we needed for a cold evening to warm up. Make sure to make reservations as The Dolar Shop does get quick busy. We had 6 people so we made sure to get there on time. 

They gave us a table to order - drinks of course came first then we decided on food.  They have an all day happy hour menu. 

For food, each person had to decide on the base broth and we decided on toppings Then selection of proteins and veggies we wanted.... Also, what type of noodles one wanted as well.. decisions decisions. Once all was placed,  our server would confirm then start bring out the food for us to cook.  Ribeye was good...of course. Yes, it is a bit pricey though when you add it all up.

All the sauces and additional toppings and desserts were in the back. this included instructions on how to make your own panda ice jelly. So make sure to leave room for dessert. 

Be careful as you cook as the temperature of the pot does steam up and they do bring water to continue to cook. 

Pro tip - don't wear your finest clothes as you will smell like hot pot when you leave.  The location is a few blocks from the train station so there is a bit of a walk depending where you come from. 

Overall food and service were good and very filling. Good for a cold nite out to warm one up.

This place is overpriced à la carte, but cheaper with an ordered set. We did not want to order an individual set because we are not very hungry and do not want to waste food. It is just ridiculous that the soup base costs $9.99; it is considered bland, especially the tomato soup paste. The beef short rib was soft; it melted in your mouth. The only thing that is worth the price. The mocktail/cocktail is not worth the price. Customer service was so so, I got blamed when the tablet was below 10% battery, and by the time I wanted to pay, the tablet was dead. 

There is a CC processing fee if you use a credit card. Just a heads up.

I loved how everything was set up and tasted! It truly felt like a premium hot pot experience. The pork broth was fantastic and you can season it with as much or as little as you'd like. The meats were delicious and at the end of it all we were happy and full. The service was impeccable as well. Any questions we had the server was there to help us, he was very patient and recommended the best choices! The ambience was also 10/10 it's very clean, lost of family and friends of all ages were there and I will go as far as to say the other customers were super nice as well hahaha  anyways I'll be back when in the area again. Check em out!

Soup bases are some of the best I've had. Items were good but not stand out. One of the few places in Manhattan with a large enough dining table for large parties of a dozen or so people. Service is attentive but could be friendlier. Their sauce / dessert bar is great. Overall a bit pricey but you are definitely paying for ambiance.

Quality wise, this might be one of the best hot pot places in Manhattan. The meat and veggies are both really tasty and fresh, and are complemented by a solid sauce bar and various types of broths to choose from. There are also a variety of non hotpot options, though our group didn't get as much of those items. My only gripe is that it isn't AYCE (apparently it's only AYCE if there's a certain amount of people in your party?) and the price can start adding up, but I think for the quality of the food compared to some other hotpot places it is somewhat justified. 

There was a generous amount of seating in the restaurant (we were able to get a reservation for a table of 14), and the staff were friendly and accommodating. This was a fun and tasty place to get dinner, and I will definitely be back again.

Wagyu and short rib and ribeye were all great, in that order. They got us in for V Day in half the time they expected and the server made us some of his fav sauces to go along with the protein, veg, and rice. Really fun evening!

Let's start off 2026 with a review on the best meal we had on our nyc trip. Individual set meals with unlimited refills on udon noodles. Udon noodles are basically what my kids would only eat at hot pot places anyways so it was an amazing deal for us (The usual place we go to back in LA charges $3 per small bowl of udons to cook.). 

In addition, they have a full bar of snacks, sweets, and make your own dessert soup. 

Did I mention they are super kid friendly? Our server, before we even got our menu, already handing out little toys to my kids. Totally won all of us over before we even see food on the table. 
 
Loved the foods, service, ambiance - everything about this place!

I've been wanting to come here for a while, but since it's not in our neighborhood, we only really remember it when we happen to be nearby. The first time we tried, they told us they had no availability even though we could see several open tables. We didn't argue or make a scene, just left and didn't come back for a long time.

Recently a friend told me they're actually very good, so we decided to give them another chance. We arrived around 12:05 on a random Tuesday. They were still setting up, so we waited about 5-10 minutes and then were seated.

As first timers, we got a quick intro to the menu. You can order individual sets or a la carte from the iPad. What we didn't realize is that the individual pots can have two broths, which is something usually reserved for larger shared pots. That was a very pleasant surprise and definitely a plus for a future visit.

The sauce station in the back wasn't as extensive as some AYCE places, but everything was noticeably fresher. Our individual sets turned out to be the perfect amount of food and included a little bit of everything we would have ordered anyway. I mistakenly ordered extra spam, not realizing the set already came with it. It was good, but we didn't need the extra food and ended up having trouble finishing it.

The creamy pork broth was rich and flavorful, and all of the ingredients were super fresh. We thoroughly enjoyed the meal. At the end they offer vanilla soft serve in a sugar cone, which was a nice way to finish.

The price was cheaper than the AYCE spots, and we left just as satisfied. If anything, the food quality and broth flavor here were better. We'll definitely be back.

Had so much fun eating at this restaurant 
It is pricey but the quality and experience is worth the price
It was a fun experience to build our custom made meal and have it cook right in front of us. A very interactive and festive dinner experience!

Probably one of the best hot pot places in the city based on quality of ingredients, though the pricing is higher than other hot pot places. Definitely worth it though in my opinion, and the presentation of the food as well as the service is exceptional. Highly recommend!

Delicious hot pot with a wide variety of meats, sides, and desserts! I ordered the mushroom truffle soup which was very rich in umami flavor. Our servers were friendly. They also have a variety of desserts including jellies, soft serve, and toppings.

I LOVE Dolar Shop. Ice cream was sooo good and it's free. Spicy broth was a perfect balance. Sauce bar had many options including sweets for after meal. Meat always tastes premium and every cut is good. Love the noodles. I go to Dolar Shop a lot and would definitely recommend!

I came here last year and loved this place. Each person gets their personal hotpot, ingredients are good quality, and their sauce bar / dessert / fried food bar is fairly extensive and you finish your meal with a vanilla ice cream cone. A la carte gets pretty pricey, though, so I didn't get around to coming back until I heard about their late-night AYCE promo, which is such a good deal in NYC (we made a res in advance). Definitely will try to go again before the promo disappears.

I miss having a Dolar Shop in Flushing, but happy that this Manhattan location is still around! Came for dinner recently for their a la carte hotpot (AYCE is only after 9:30pm). The soup bases and sauces are always so freakin' good. I love getting the split pot with the creamy pork broth and the spicy soup base. The "less spicy" version of the spicy broth is already pretty spicy; would pass on the sichuan level spice. All of the food is of really good quality and portions are pretty decent for a la carte prices. Service is attentive with broth refills. My only gripe is that the ventilation at this location is not the best despite the restaurant being quite spacious. Definitely expect to smell a like hotpot after leaving.

Solid hot pot spot in the east village the features individualized bowls rather than the more traditional, shared larger pots. 

Service is typical for a hotpot spot. You order from an iPad and food shows up. There's a sauce bar where you can make your sauces. Servers are quick to help if you ask for it.

Food was good. Nothing revolutionary but solid quality with the usual hot pot items. The meat was tender and the seafood was fresh. Produce was well trimmed and prepared as well. I did feel that this place was a bit expensive for what they're offering, but I wouldn't say it's a bad value. 

Note: there's AYCE after 9:30pm. Haven't tried it, but it has piqued my interest.

The service here is really good and the staff was friendly. They were attentive and helped me out when the ice cream machine was not working. The atmosphere is lively and modern.

The broths were flavorful and delicious. The meats were tender and great quality. They have a self-service bar, which offered a variety of sauces and desserts.  The vanilla ice cream was so delicious and addicting. Their plum and watermelon juice were refreshing and not too sweet. I would definitely come back here again.

The soup bases here are amazing. The "silver soup," which is their white pepper pork broth, is absolutely delicious. The tomato and oxtail soup bases are also impressive--definitely among my favorites I've tried in New York City. The soup base comes with chicken and pork stomach strips, adding great texture and flavor.  

We ordered the prime beef, sliced very thin at about $30, and a seafood platter featuring scallops, fresh tiger shrimp, oysters, and shrimp paste. The waiter shapes the shrimp paste into small balls for easier cooking, and you can actually see chunks of shrimp in each piece--it's definitely a highlight. We also ordered various vegetables, tofu, and mushroom dishes. The total bill, pre-tax, came to around $150 for two adults and a 5-year-old, making this a fairly pricey spot.  

The sauce bar is one of the best I've seen. Their sha cha, beef, and shrimp sauces taste homemade and are incredibly flavorful, with plenty of ingredients to mix your own combination. The dessert bar stands out too, with Chinese jade jelly, different types of tapioca balls, tasty red bean paste, and a variety of toppings like pistachios and other nuts.  

However, cleanliness is a major issue. Many customers are young, and the sauce and dessert bars often appear neglected--messy and not cleaned promptly. Random items are scattered around the walls, open cabinets, and even on tables used for storage. The open kitchen looks disorganized. It's clear the owner has a great concept and high-quality ingredients, but the operations feel poorly managed--more like a chaotic street-side eatery in China than a Manhattan restaurant.  

Though the food is excellent, the untidy dining environment is a big downside. A bit more care and organization could truly elevate the entire experience.

It was absolutely delicious and so affordable for such fantastic food and so many options! The workers were super kind and very attentive and helpful, and I personally loved that each customer got their own pot. Plus the sauce bar was awesomeee.
Set menu is delicious.  Excellent service as well.  Broth is topped off all the time.  There's a server around whenever I needed something.

This place was really good! I recc getting the tomato broth, it was sweet and tasty. The meat was good too and the sides. Our server was really great and super friendly. The place was packed for the weekend so make sure to reserve ahead!
My favorite restaurant in NYC. Your own personalized hot pot! Great service, great food, love the complimentary ice cream cone at the end to cleanse the palate. Highly recommended!

the new after 11pm feast ayce for $29.99 has to be one of the best quality to cost hotpots in the city. we reserved for a party of 6 friday night and were glad we did since it was packed even at 11pm. this was my first time here and i was definitely impressed. the meat selection depends on what price package u get and are brought by waiters but all other hotpot ingredients are self serve including sauce and dessert station. was especially pleased with the veggie freshness and variety including taro and quail eggs. meat is high quality and clean cut. creamy pork broth was my favorite but tomato was good too. complementary soft serve is amazing. the place is pretty clean for how busy it is and i personally thought service was friendly and reasonable given it was 12am.

If you're looking for a premium late-night feast in Manhattan, The Dolar Shop is the spot. I came here at 10:30pm for their late-night all-you-can-eat hot pot ($45.99 per person, every day 9:30PM-12AM) and it was incredible.

The quality of the meats really stood out--tender beef short plate, juicy chicken thigh, lamb flap, and pork belly, all sliced fresh and perfect for hot pot. On top of that, there are over 50 extras to choose from--seafood, veggies, noodles, tofu, and even desserts. Everything was fresh and kept coming nonstop.

The vibe is modern, sleek, and fun--perfect for groups of friends or anyone who gets hungry after hours. Service was attentive and quick, which made the whole experience even better.

Honestly, $45.99 for premium all-you-can-eat hot pot in Manhattan feels like such a steal. I'll definitely be back whenever those late-night cravings hit!

I was here for lunch. This Dolar Shop is across from the AMC. They have a spacious venue. This is hot pot but not AYCE!

I was confused how to order, but the easiest way is to get the set. You choose meat, soup, and appetizer. Then they give you a veggie plate. It's a lot of food. The flat iron beef set is only $26.99, so I think that's a pretty good deal for all the food you get. Each person has their individual stove and hot pot. You can adjust the heat yourself.

There is a buffet-style condiment and dessert bar in the back. Those gummies got me!! I was eating so many gummy worms and gummy bears before the food arrived. The napkins and chopsticks are on the drawer under the table. 

Service was great! They were so nice. I was here to celebrate a birthday, and that's what we indicated on the reservation.  They provided a scratch card and honored that promo for that meal! 

Bathroom is downstairs. (Elevator available, but it said staff only)
No Wifi.
Credit card/Apple Pay accepted. (3% credit card fee)
^If you fill out a survey, you get the 3% fee waived. We got this in addition to the birthday promo!

Delicious hot pot and broth with good service but definitely very pricey. a la carte was $54 a person but i was definitely very full so could probably order less. 
I really enjoy the dessert bar at the end to make a coconut milk mochi fruit soup. That was a highlight that is also unique to this place. Because of the price point, i would consider going again if someone else suggested but it wouldn't be top of mind for me.

Did I have a good time here and enjoy the food? Yes. But upon leaving, I saw that they have a C sanitation/inspection rating that was NOT being displayed for customers to see outside. Instead, it was inside the building and we only noticed it by mistake. The service was good but I would have never ate here if I knew they had such a low rating. It's actually gross and a health concern.

The restaurant's appearance sets expectations correctly. Since moving here, this spot has become important to me. Extraordinary customer standards. Their dishes are remarkably tasty. I'm honestly attached to this spot, and you will be too.

They make you feel like you belong. You get a lot on your plate and the salad stood out. The server attention was impressive and the restaurant has an ideal spot. Their workers performed well without fluctuation. When visiting this location, I'll return.

I'll say this is the best hotpot place in the city! It's just so good that makes me wanna comeback within a week!( and yes I did went back in 2 days) 
The food quality is great! The shrimp ball is so good! I highly recommend whoever wants hotpot!
It's fine I guess. This sure isn't Japanese Shabu Shabu though. If you're looking for standard hot pot. This place will fit the bill. If you're specifically looking for Shabu Shabu, this ain't it.

Very good trendy but pricey hot pot spot. Presentation is great and you should make a reservation to avoid a wait. If you are new to hot pot I would definitely give it a try because it's less intimidating compared to other hot pot places.
They have all you can eat after 10pm on Friday, Saturday, etc. You order meat on tablet. The sides, vegetables, sauces, are self-serve. Highly recommend

Yelp's suggestion feature connected me with my new favorite restaurant. Their dishes maintain standards and the setting adds value. Employees are both friendly and professional. You'll find good value with big portions. Experience what this restaurant offers - it's quality.

Food's great, I come here a lot. The quality never lets me down. Highly recommend the creamy pork broth, don't just get spicy. You can always spice up with sauce.
Would've given a 5 a couple years back but they changed their sauce station up and removed a bunch of stuff (also weirdly removed the labels so I have to awkwardly smell it to know what I'm getting...)
Service is always great.

Went to AYCE past 930 and best hot pot experience ever! Lots of fresh meat options, the broth is tasty and you can get 2 different ones in one pot. They give you an iPad and you choose everything that you want and they bring everything out very quickly. Only downside is after a while all the meat kinda starts tasting the same and you don't know which one is which. Free Icecream cone at the end. Would recommend and def will be back

This hotpot was very mid. I'm not saying it was bad but you can get better hotpot for the same price. The meat quality isn't so good and the sauce bar was missing some of my favorite sauces. I asked one of the employees to replace the jar of a sauce and he completely ignored me but I didn't let it get in the way of my dinner. Waited 2 1/2 hours to get a table for 1. I would recommend to put your name down 1-2 hrs before your intended time and/or make a reservation

I'm a big fan of personal hot pot and really enjoyed my experience at The Dolar Shop. The soup base was delicious and the ingredients seemed very fresh. There was a ton of seating inside as well as complimentary fruit water while you're waiting. Our sever was very attentive and helped answer all of our questions. Highly recommend! The spicy broth was my favorite and the set meal was a decent amount of food. There's a sauce bar where you can self serve sauces and desserts. They also give you complimentary ice cream at the end of your meal.
simply spectacular in my humble opinion I would have to rate this...5/5 stars. didn't take any pics because we vacuumed all the food...it was that GOOD! shrimp paste was a wonderful surprise

This is my another go to place for hot pot. So many choices to pick from seasoning, meat, seafood, veggie and desert, especially some Asian desert.  A5 is the best choice for meat, like their hand pull noodle, try their different fine cut fruit to make your own desert to finish your meal. This location has enough space for small and large groups， wait time is not long even if you have no reservation. Service is good. Very clean and well arranged.

You can choose two soups in one pot and it's a personal pot per person. I personally liked the creamy pork soup + spicy creamy. Lots of topping options. I recommend mixing the dessert options together + ice cream + condense milk (thank me later).

Have been coming for their AYCE after 9:30 for the past two weeks and this may be my new favorite AYCE hotpot in NYC! 

This place only had personal pot but you're able to do two different broths per personal pot. I have tried their spicy, tomato and bone broth and my personal favorite is the tomato and bone broth combo. 

The best thing about their hotpot was the quality of their meat. Sliced beef in AYCE hotpot is usually way too lean or way too fatty but the beef was perfect here! My favorite cut was their USDA rib eye and I would recommend only getting that cut for beef! 

Their veggies, seafood, and noodles were self-served on the market table. There were a lot of options and I loved how I can just grab it myself so I could control the amount and reduce food waste. They also had a lot of dessert options and you can also ask them for a mini soft serve! 

The AYCE was only $46 per person and this was so worth it for the quality of the food. The service was also amazing the last two times when I was there. Highly recommend coming here if you don't mind waiting until 9:30! I was able to walk in for the last two times but I would recommend making a reservation if you can!
First time dining here. The food is great with lots of options--especially the tofu dishes, so tender! But a bit pricey, haha
I always keep coming back and being more people! If you're looking for a fun night to enjoy sharing a meal with friends or family, this is the right place!

Pretty popular hot pot place in the east village. Service was pretty quick and we tried the beef, lamb, shrimp pate, enoki mushrooms, and vegetables. You can get sauces and toppings for ice cream in the back.

Such an amazing experience, I think by far the best Hot Pot I have had !! They have this new Spring Set Menu for less than $50 , so worth it !! Definitely give them a shot if you in East Village. 
Service top notch , Kevin our waiter was great and explained everything. Place is huge plenty of room for big groups but reservations recommend.
Love that you get individual hotpots and even then can still get 2 flavour broths. The AYCE was being set up as we finished- too bad it wasn't available earlier in the evening!

Any all you can eat dining experience HATES to see me and my big bro coming. Big bro is from Taiwan, and is more protein oriented than any other human being I've ever met, and his physique is proof. He's JACKED. He's like an Asian Johnny Bravo. 

I'll always recommend restaurants and he'll text back with "ehhh I'm just not seeing a lot of protein on the menu." 

When I recommended Dolar Shop, a Chinese hot pot restaurant in the East Village, I got the "I'm down" text. Those are tough to get from big bro.

We walked in ready to go HAM, as it's all you can eat past 9:30pm for $46. We always get our money's worth out of an all you can eat restaurant. 

Hot Pot is cool because you pick your broth, mix your sauces from the sauce bar, and get full plates of raw meat and cook them right in the flavorful, boiling hot broth. This is only my 2nd time having hotpot, and it's such a unique dining experience. I've found the best way to learn about a culture when you can't hop on a plane is to try the food.

Our feast consisted of the following: Flat Iron Beef (3x), Beef Boneless Short Rib, Chuck Eye Roll, New Zealand Lamb Flap, Beef Short Plate, Rib Eye, A Choy, Sweet Corn, and the Fish Roe Balls. Our favorite was the flat iron beef, as we got three orders of it. 

After our meal, we were as full as Ben Simmons after he got a max contract, but there is always room for soft serve ice cream. If there are two things in life I am an expert on, they are soft serve ice cream and rotisserie chicken. This soft serve was ELITE.

I was feeling myself and tried to do the DQ Blizzard test on it, and failed miserably. My ice cream fell straight into the hotpot. I almost tried to cook some meat in my new ice cream flavored broth, but took the cowards way out. I'll be better next time, all I can do is try to improve everyday.
