Tiktok @jnov__

First time at a hot pot that wasn't all you can eat but honestly, this place was amazing. It was on the pricer side but good quality ingredients and they did have unlimited noodles (my fave was udon), dessert and apps for you to choose from. It ended up being more than enough food by itself. I really enjoyed the wagyu and the lamb. The staff was attentive and helpful, everything was fresh and the broth was so flavorful. I would recommend waiting for the $46 AYCE starting at 9:30pm. I also recommend you make reservations for this place. It was packed when we got there at 7pm. You can avoid the 3% credit card fee if you bring cash or use debit.

I always love coming back to this spot for their premium AYCE hotpot but today was my first time trying their lunch spring set menu and I have to give it a 5/5 as well! 

For the lunch set, there's an app, main course, broth, veggie platter, and unlimited starch & desert (the main course is a couple dollars extra on the weekends & holidays!) I got the flat iron beef and assorted platter. For broth, I got half tomato and half spicy. Both super flavorful and delicious!
It's a big portion of food that keeps you super full! And you have unlimited choice of noodles so you can load up if you're still feeling hungry lol. The staff were so nice and quick with serving the food!  

Overall, I think this lunch set menu is pretty worth it compared to the AYCE option because the AYCE menu is kinda $$$ and realistically how much can you eat??  Just love how the restaurant overall feels very clean and organized, and I will be back another time to munch!

This place was a BLAST!!! The vibe inside was so nice and the tables were great. They accommodate larger groups which was perfect!! They had a bunch of "sets" which you could get that was pretty perfect. Comes with an app, a platter of your meat of choice, various veggies, noodles, and UNLIMITED SOFT SERVE!!!

The hot pot was great, I loved that everyone gets their own personal small pot! As opposed to other places where the table has one large pot and you have to have a designated cooker and you lose track of whats going in lol. Here everyone got to choose their own items and their own broth flavors. I got the smooth pork broth which was very well flavored and creamy, as well as the spicy broth which had a nice amount of heat to it.

Starting with the app, I chose the cucumber salad and it was pretty tasty! Sweet, salty, refreshing, fun to eat.

For the meat I chose the flat iron beef, idk why this one was calling to me but it was really good. It cooked so quick like about 10-15 seconds in the broth.

I chose the deluxe veggie platter for my sides and I'm so glad I did because it came with PUMPKIN and POTATOES!!! I put the potatoes in right at the start so that theyd cook about halfway into my meal. The pumpkin was amazinggggg so genius to have that in hot pot. The rest of the veggies were standard but really nice to have.

For the noodles I chose the hand pulled noodles and they were really nice too. Very very long so I recommend ripping them in half before you put them in to cook because fishing them out was so difficult, but well worth it because they soak up the broth really well.

They also had a sauce bar to make your own sauces. They premade us one that was pretty good but i'm all about that sesame and garlic sauce so I went and made that and it was so good.

The sauce bar also had a bunch of other goodies like candies and little panda marshmallows which was perfect for... THE UNLIMITED SOFT SERVE!!!  And it was my FAVORITE kind of soft serve like the one that is a bit watery and icey but still vanilla and delish. Wowww i could eat gallons of that.

What a GREAT place I had so much fun here!!! I love it I love it I love it I love it I love it I love it I looooove ittttt
This is my favorite place to go. The broth is beyond creamy/flavorful. The sides are delicious. The little ice cream at the end is my fav!

I've been to a few hotpot spots and this was good, but not amazing! i was seated pretty quickly (especially when everywhere else had a 30-90 minute wait) and the waiter came over to explain how it worked, but it was difficult to understand him. I'm use to unlimited sides/meats, but the only thing that was included was one offering of vegetables, 2 broth selections, a small portion of ribeye & unlimited noodles for $42. I also went to the buffet table and got oranges, honeydew, thinly sliced mangos, shrimp chips and I saw a lot of jello. Everything was delicious, place was clean and I was full when I left but I wouldn't go out of my way to return.
Always the best hotpot spot. The best quality and also the presentation is always so nice. Love the complimentary soft serve at the end.

We were lucky enough to have Kai serving us, and he was attentive and very good. We had three children in our group and he was very nice to them. The food was excellent we ordered the fish and beef and as usual they did not disappoint. The ambience is cool and modern with bustling activity so very pleasant.

A 3.8 experience for me. 

Pros:
- Great location, diagonal from the movie theater on 11th street and 3rd Ave in EV, easy access to the green line trains and Union Square
- desserts! There is vanilla ice cream but the sauces station also has additional dessert options and snacks! 
- good portions of food sizes that came in a decorative holder, which helps with food waste. I
- aprons, although we weren't given it as the first customers that entered the restaurant this evening. I like the thoughtfulness of this for customers 
- customer service was very nice
- clean bathroom, which I appreciate

Cons:
- very small pot and the soup base is very oily I scooped out a whole little bowl of the oil
- the sliced meat were quiet fatty
- there were no utensils other than the ones available on the table I had to ask for an additional spoon for dessert. It wasn't readily available on the sauce and dessert bar

$40-$45/person. Two people plus taxes and tips you can expected to pay about $125.
Never fails to go to dolar shop! Food always good and good service! Perfect for family lunch/dinner

Very unique hot pot experience. Fun with a group or even on your own! 

Each person at your table has their own broth station and a basket with a combo of choice. I've only been to ones where you share the pot. But here, you choose a broth flavor and have the soup pot on a personal electric stove. 

Also! You choose your order on an iPad, which was super confusing especially because of restaurant week. There were options that added to the cart that weren't an actual order just descriptions. Luckily there was a girl who came around to help people get their order in. 

I went with the mushroom broth, the only non-pork option they have aside from veggie. I wish there was chicken or beef one but alas. For the combo I got flat iron beef combo I think. So many choices I don't remember what I ended up going with. 

Since it was restaurant week, it came with 
- cucumber or tomato salad
- tower of meat and veggie baskets 
- side of rice
- soft serve
Looks like too much food but in the end I wasn't too full. I wish there was more meat in the combo. 

I loved the extensive sauce and dessert stations. You go and make your bowl yourself. Lots of fruits too which was perfect after the hot pot. 

Overall really fun! A little overwhelming if it's your first time but after the first, you'll know what you like.
Really great selection of meats, seafood and noodles to add to broths. I love that they have the make your own sauce bar which also has some fruits and appetizers at it.

It was 9pm on a weekday and I was craving hot pot...what to do?
I saw that Dolar Shop is open until midnight during the week and they have AYCE hot pot after 9:30pm!

We arrived at around 9:30pm. The restaurant was about half-full and bustling with different groups. Our server was so friendly and helpful. He explained the ordering system to us and gave us some time to get situated. The AYCE doesn't have all of the items that are available during the day/for a la carte, but it's likely more than enough to satiate your hot pot cravings. Each diner gets their own individual pot and you can even get a split pot. I got half creamy pork broth and half tomato broth. Both were delicious! 

We tried several of the meats - my favorites were the pork belly, lamb shoulder and the rib eye. From the AYCE bar, I liked the shrimp, fish roe balls, bamboo shots, and seaweed knots. Our waiter even brought over a plate of his favorites/recommendations from the AYCE bar. You also get to end the meal with some delicious soft serve!

I'm knocking one star because at $45 per person, I think you can get better AYCE hot pot value and variety elsewhere, but if you're around 14th Street and not looking to head to a different neighborhood, this might be your spot.

as meat eater, i enjoyed it. however, there were so many people it felt like our waiter was constantly running around.

however, i took my vegan boyfriend, thinking their veggie dinner set would work. turns out all their sauces have an animal products. the cucumber salada does as well. doesn't seem like the price was worth it for his meal. he didn't even get tofu because that also had meat in it.

First time doing hotpot and it hit the spot on a cold, dreary day. The servers were very friendly in explaining the many menu options and the cooking process. The special set was a great bargain for $25.99 and included veggies, meat, tofu and even some shrimp with a choice of noodles or rice. Before the meal, a dipping sauce was made tableside. They came around to offer extra broth, but I didn't need any. 
Free ice cream cone was a nice surprise treat! Super clean and will definitely return.
Delicious and fresh ingredients; quality meats; bright and clean restaurant setting; excellent service; wonderful broth choices.

Dolar shop is a great spot in the east village with consistently good meat, soup bases, and side offerings. I'd say the place is a bit pricey but in New York I think it's par for the course. Staff is pretty quick and I enjoy ordering via the iPad.

Will absolutely be coming back!

Great value hot pot if you come during their lunch hours! They have discounted sets that come with your choice of meat (which dictates the price) and a plate of assorted veggies, shrimp, tofu! 
As a group of 6, we wanted to try different meats, so we ordered 6 sets and also supplemented with a few more plates of meat and veggies. But we all left SUPER full and satisfied
The creamy pork soup is really good! I opted for the half pork and half tomato broth. My husband said the medium level of spicy was pretty spicy, so beware! 
All the cuts of meat were good quality, just depends on how fatty you want it

I'd definitely recommend making a reservation since it gets packed during peak hours, but we were able to make one same day 

They don't have the biggest drink selection, but it is nice that they give you soft serve at the end!

*Cash discount, or they waive the credit card fee if you take a survey

Reviewing the lunch/afternoon set menu (offered 11am-5pm) that Dolar Shop offers. Tldr: it's worth.

I visited with a friend on a Saturday noon reservation. We each got a lunch set, and picked different cuts of beef. For broths, I split mine half creamy pork broth and half spicy broth with mild spice level. I was a huge fan of both, though the mild was pretty spicy and I ended up using the pork broth more. Portions were enough for my friend and I (both having skipped breakfast) to be completed satiated. All the ingredients were good quality and I enjoyed the variety. Service was prompt, water was always filled, and food arrived quickly.

For context, the set comes with a cut of meat you choose and a tray of hotpot items, like lettuce, enoki mushrooms, imitation crab, shrimp balls, bean curd skin, spam, chicken, and so on. You can order unlimited servings of rice or noodles, which we took advantage of a couple times. At a buffet, in addition to concocting dipping sauces you can get unlimited helpings of kimchi, seaweed salad, AND dessert - think taro balls, ice jelly, red bean, popping boba, diced dragon fruit and mango, marshmallows, orange slices, gummy bears, etc. Don't forget there's free vanilla ice cream, which the waiter offered to us at the very end, long after we'd stuffed ourselves.

The ambience of this restaurant feels more polished and tidy than that of other hotpot spots where AYCE is the only draw. You'll see that reflected in perhaps the slightly higher prices here, but the quality is there and the lunch set is a good deal IMO. In total (tax + tip) I forked out $39, which is not bad for this experience; there is no shortage of bougie brunches in the city that will rack up a much higher bill. No doubt I'll be back here again.

Had a great time there. The servers: Alex and Kelvin were a great help (didn't get the other servers name). Everyone was friendly there, the atmosphere was nice, professional, and of great help during our time there. I will be coming back with my friends later again. Strongly recommend the creamy soup too.
This spot is my go-to. The food hits different, the service is always amazing, and the items arrive really quickly. This is my friends and I favorite spot.

The atmosphere of this place is very nice. Good place to have family dinner.
Their menu is explained with pictures on a tablet which makes easier for the first time visitors. Server was also nice and wanted to help ordering.
I loved how everyone was getting individual pots and could choose up to 2 different soup base. I ordered pork bone & spicy which were both good. They didn't have that much variety of sauces but still I was very satisfied with the food. They also have a little section where you can make your own dessert which was cute.

I've been to Dolar shop two times. The first time was at 6 pm and we spent $100 pp and were stuffed. The second time was at 11 pm for their AYCE late night option and we spent $50-60 pp and were stuffed. The first time I doubted the worth, but the second time was definitely worth it. I really appreciated Dolar shop's high quality ingredients and ability to choose my own portions for ingredients, since the AYCE layout is buffet style for everything but the meat. No other hotpot place could compare after having theirs. 

I would recommend the late night option to someone looking to get the best value out of this restaurant.

Looking for a top tier hot pot spot in NYC....look no further. 

My boyfriend and I arrived at this place super hungry and very close to closing and they still welcomed us with the utmost hospitality. 

As a bonus to start your meal, there's a whole unlimited salad bar with a variety of Asian and American classics that were abundant, delicious, and fresh, even for late in the evening. We did not do the all you can eat since it was late and we didn't want to be inconsiderate so close to closing time, but there are many other options besides the all you can eat. You can choose everything from veggies, meat, noddles or rice and types/levels of broth. All was fresh, plentiful and absolutely delicious.

Prices were very fair, service was top notch, and to top off the whole meal....they give you a cute little ice cream cone as a parting gift (which was delicious).

Great quality fresh meats and other ingredients. Absolutely loved the portions for the AYCE opportunity. Very nice and helpful staff and quick service. It was quite packed considering the NYU students in the area. 

Pretty sad about their sister location closing in Flushing, but this will do for the price of an AYCE.
Fantastic food, awesome staff. Always leave feeling stuffed in a good way. Free ice cream dessert too.

(Overall: B) - The Dolar Shop has an noticeably large selection for their AYCE option, featuring classic cuts like brisket and pork belly, as well as more adventurous cuts like beef aorta. Their sauce bar also has a good mix of classic sauces, but what stands out is that they have a dessert bar with fresh fruit to help balance the hearty hotpot meal. I did find the restaurant seating and table arrangement to be a bit tight, and the fumes from the hotpot to persist through my clothes the following days, which is less than ideal -- I think bringing a large plastic bag to counteract this would be smart. The staff seemed very busy, although they still were attentive enough and the food came out at a reasonable pace in my opinion. Not a bad choice for hotpot. 

Food: +1
Presentation: E
Price: E
Atmosphere: E
Service: E
Menu: +1
Overall: +2 B

Insta/Beli/TikTok: @amei_eats

This is an elevated hot pot experience where you can order a la carte during the day and AYCE at night from 9:30PM to midnight. My group of 4 visited on a Saturday evening and it was pretty packed - that being said we unfortunately sat where there was no air conditioning or vent so it got super hot. 

Other than that it was pretty easy to order your broth with the server and then everything else via iPad. Unlike other hotpot places, each broth is $10. There is a buffet table with appetizers and your options to make a sauce all in one corner. We ordered sparingly each time to gauge how full we got since ordering a la carte tends to add up. The ingredients are presented very nicely, and came on a tower. They also have sets where you get a little bit of everything! And free ice cream at the end doesn't hurt. 

Overall a nice experience but it was super hot with no aircon - we were all sweating and only realized other spots in the restaurant had great aircon once we got up to leave.

Such a great experience eating so much seafood while my friend enjoyed a variety of meats. Staff are so kind and accommodating and there are phone chargers and drawers at the table! Drinks are so great too! There's also a dessert bar!

My order: Lunch set with chef's creamy broth and lamb.

We had a reservation for lunch, but there was enough space to just get a seat immediately. 
Really recommend the lunch deals, where you can get a set for half the price of the dinner one. For me, it was $25.99 for a giant soup, lamb cut, and vegetables.

We had several water refills. Servers hovered around frequently to pick up used dishes, which was really helpful because hot pot dishes tend to stack up. 

The salad bar in the back had a lot of dips, fruits, and little dessert options. I really like the selection of Ingredients here, they have all the essentials and some nice variation.

There's not a lot that can go wrong with hot pot. My Chef's creamy broth was delicious. From the selection of vegetables, I really liked the tofu roll. It has a very special and unique taste.

If anything, I could have skipped out on the chicken platter, but having too much food is never an issue
Pretty decent hot pot place in a convenient place. It gets pretty expensive if it's not all you can eat. Otherwise not bad experience.

Our first time visiting this place, and it did NOT disappoint! The ambiance was good, and the staff was super attentive and helpful. But let's be real, the highlight of the place (as it should be) was the FOOD! It was literally an explosion of flavors!

Our server Jason made this amazing spicy sauce mix that was TERRIFIC! We had the option to create it ourselves at the station, but we opted for Jason's expertise instead.

Also this was the first time we all were experiencing individual hot pot and not the usual communal style. 

Between the four of us, we ordered a variety of broths: the chef's creamy broth, a combo of spicy broth and chef's creamy broth, spicy broth, tomato broth, and medium chicken pork broth. Honestly, the table wasn't too fond of the tomato broth, but the spicy broth (especially the Szechuan spice level) was a HUGE hit!

For meats, we got the flounder filet (ABSOLUTELY THE BEST!), premium cru beef thin slices, and we even got some complimentary chicken at the beginning to add flavor to the broth.

Our veggie selection was pretty extensive: seaweed, enoki mushroom, wood ear mushroom, cabbage, lotus root, bamboo shoot, tofu... you name it! And of course, we had to get some starch to go with it, so we ordered noodles and rice.

We did TOTAL justice to the food we ordered for four people. The broth just kept getting better and better as we cooked our food!

To pair with our meal, we got the peach Soju and the original Soju. The food was a bit on the expensive side, but it was TOTALLY worth it! We can't wait to come back here with friends and family!

Food was very good and easy to order.  There many broths to choose from.

They then have a buffet of condiments and desserts as well.  They do not have the ice cream dessert at the moment.

We had a variety of things from Meat to seafood and some vegetables.

You cook the food in the broth you chose.  It usually takes about 5 minutes or less to cook the items you like.  The thermostat or temperature for keeping hot or cooking is at the knobs below the table in the sides.  

They have peanuts and edemame to snack on as appetizer.  They bring chili sauce and sauce for your food.
Very good food, I go there regularly. I like that you have individual hot pots and not a shared one.

I love the silver broth here. I would happily take home a gallon of that broth for later. The ingredients are always super fresh, the service is great, and I like the overall ambiance here. I also love that they offer complementary ice cream at the end which I always think is the perfect pairing to hotpot. I also always love hotpot spots that let you have your own pot. It is a little bit on the pricier side but I do think the experience and the fresh ingredients are worth it here.

Very delicious over priced hot pot
Would i go again? Maybe once or twice a year there is other hot pit places that are more on the affordable side
The service was okay just a lot of people
Also despite my reservation at 7:15pm, I had to wait another 10minute to enter... just a lot of people..
But food was great:)

Thought someone said Dollar store when I first heard of such a hot pot place! 

But LOVED my experience here. Customer service is S tier here!! Really felt well attended and catered to.

Food was absolutely delicious - with the different amounts of meats and veggies. Great variation for sauces and dessert as well (there is like a little bar in the back). Atmosphere was very lively and the quality of the food was amazing. 

Only thing - their fresh watermelon juice was not hitting :( think it wasn't the season but meh. 

Other than that; would totally recommend to come with friends to share all the food! (items are a la carte but i think it was so worth). Overall, 9/10 experience and taste!

My wife and I ate here yesterday.Food was very good.Service was great.Staff very helpful.Very clean,and nice ambienc.My only concern,is we were not notified about,all the rice,and noodles,were unlimited.We also were not notified about free Icecream at the end.
That would have made a difference in our enjoyment,as senior citizens,it would have made the meal more enjoyable
Paul Cohen

Dolar Shop with one l, provides an elevated hotpot experience. From the sleek interior to the heavy silverware, Dolar shops looks to portray its self as a luxury hotpot shop.

The service was speedy and the food was slightly above average. The main draw was the ambiance and presentation of the portions. Most items came out on nice dinnerware and presented its self as super tasty. I do wish the individual hotpots were a bit larger, but that is a small negative.

The highlight of the visit was the sides and dessert bar that came with your visit. Sliced mango, red bean, and even pocky sticks were available at the sauce bar.

Slightly pricey, but pretty cool experience!

This location is very big and modern! They had a drawer in the seat where we could put our belongings, which was appreciated. The tables are large and spacious. You use a tablet to order and the items come quickly. The quality is good, but it is definitely one of the more expensive options for hot pot, since you order a la carte.

They're true hot pot artisans, serving up the freshest ingredients and high-quality meats that keep me coming back.  Their handmade shrimp balls are a must-try, along with premium beef paired with unique, house-made sauces that blend East and West flavors perfectly.
I finally tried their all-you-can-eat option, and it's such a steal! For $45.99 per person, you get
55 items to choose from, available daily from 9.30 PM to 12 AM (1 hour 45 min seating limit). Plus, selected meats are 50% off!  Perfect for late-night foodies looking for quality and value.
And don't forget to check out their new cocktails and mocktails to complete the experience! 

Featuring 
Sunset Glow cocktail
Crush Grape Gummy
Fresh watermelon juice
AYCE hotpot

Follow @spinx17 For more NYC food recs!

Great hot pot place, different from your normal AYCE shops. A bit on the pricier end but you're definitely paying more the experience. Everyone gets their own personal pot, which is fun, but part of me enjoys having a shared pot more (sometimes I like to fight for my food, ya know?)

You order a la carte via a digital menu, and they bring the plates out and serve them on a fancy tiered platter. They have a self serve sauce station with everything you could want in a hot pot sauce (and they do offer to make their house sauce for you) as well as fruits, some traditional Asian side dishes (edamame, peanuts, seaweed) and a DIY drinks area with jellies and syrups. 

We finished our meal with their free soft serve.

Would recommend checking out!
Food is fresh. Service is excellent. With an individual hot pot by yourself, you can select your soup base. The beef is a favorite choice and the noodle is also popular.

Dolar shop is my favorite hot pot place in nyc! The service is always amazing. The waiters are always super attentive and you don't even need ask them to refill your broth because they will automatically do it for you. I always get the exquisite silver and the mala broth. It is a la carte during the day but becomes AYCE at 9pm. You also get a soft serve at the end of the meal. If dolar shop has one fan, it's me! If dolar shop has no fans, I am dead!
Amazing service and the best hotpot ingredients in city, thick cut beef is a MUST try, so tender and it's melting in your mouth
Great value to come here after 9pm for the AYCE. Meat is good for the price you pay. Good selections on other hot pot items. I would personally just stay with their rib eye.

Dolar Shop is pretty good for hot pot. The place is spacious and their set meals are a good deal. The ingredients are fresh and the self-service stations for sauce/fruit/dessert is solid. Service can be pretty spotty though.

I always have a great experience at the Dolar Shop. The workers are so helpful and friendly, the food quality is amazing and they don't skimp out, the restaurant itself is spacious and comfortable. 

I wish they would add sriracha to the sauce bar tho!!!!!!

Soup bases and sauce were delicious!  Meat were fresh.  Great quality for the price.  Service was good too.  Restaurant was pretty full with lunch crowd on a weekday.  Generally, nice and clean environment.   Ambiance was good.

One of the best hot pot places in the city (manhattan). I definitely recommend getting a reservations for more crowded times. Everything is super fresh and super clean. The service was fast and helpful. It is not ACYE so we ordered a set, and we were pretty full. The sauce bar had its usual variety and there was even extra dessert (?) things for the end. Overall, this spot is worth it even though it's a little pricey. I just am not a big fan of having to pay for the soup, I think it should be included with the amount we're paying for the ingredients. Also it was just me and one other person, so I wish we just shared one big pot.

Lovely restaurant with a vibrant yet relaxing vibe! They also take reservations for dinner which is great to have when you don't want to wait hours.
Fantastic dining experience. 
Everything we tried, from the cocktails, the food, and the desserts, were all delicious! 
I can't wait to go back again soon.
Thank you to our server, kai, for the great service :)

Food: This is an à la carte hot pot restaurant. The quality of the hot pot items is very good. The broth is also delicious and you can choose from pork, spicy, mushroom, and tomato. They have an extensive sauce bar, which also includes some fruits, dessert, and appetizers such as marinated tripe and kimchi.

Service: Service is phenomenal at this restaurant. Staff are very friendly and welcoming. They are attentive and are constantly collecting empty dishes, refilling broth, and checking on you.

Ambiance: There are a good number of tables at this restaurant which accommodate both smaller and larger groups. Seating is comfortable and spacious with booths.  

Overall, I would recommend this place for hot pot!

the dolar shop is one of my favorite hotpot spots in the city with their extensive menu, quality ingredients, and DIY dessert bar!! one of my favorite features is that everyone has their own mini hotpot so it really is customized to your own preference.

the broths are extremely flavorful and they have a huge selection of sauces you can use to make your own. although the ingredients are quite pricey, they do not skimp out on the portion sizes and you'll definitely leave full. my favorite part would have to be the complimentary soft serve at the end - it's like the cherry on top.

not to mention they now have an AYCE menu everyday from 9PM-12AM for only $45.99!! we all know how hotpot can get $$$ so now your late night bite won't break the bank~

One of the pricier hot pot establishments, but the broth is extremely flavorful, and the house sauce they mix at your table is similar to what I enjoy making at other locations that have sauce bars; quality of the overall ingredients is very high, and the portions for the veggie options can be easily split between 2 people, unless you're a fatty.

Chicken and pork, from what I assume must be the excess from the stock they make in-house, can come with the soup at no additional charge, so take that into consideration before you pile on protein choices for a-la-carte.

All you can eat is at 9:30pm after.

Overall, I'd come back here again, as it pretty much overshadows everything we have in the Bay Area.
Hot pot concept is nice. Food was excellent but the restaurant is noisy and the athmosphere was a bit hechtic.

LOVE LOVE LOVE. Best enjoyed with friends, to get to try the most stuff. We got a smattering of items, the shrimp, a beef plate, a mixed beef/pork plate, and some shitake mushrooms, and everything clocked in at about $60 a person, which for a fun dining/date night experience in NYC seems very fair. The staff were friendly, the sauce bar was so fun, and the broths were SOOOOO good and spicy! I can't wait to go back.

Let me tell you why this is my absolute favorite hot pot spot. First off, you get your own individual pot--no need to share, which is a game-changer! Plus, their sauce selection is fantastic, and they even have a spicy mushroom sauce, which is my personal favorite and something you won't find at every hot pot place.

The variety of fresh beef and seafood is incredible, with top-tier options like Wagyu and A5 Miyazaki. The quality is unbeatable--melt-in-your-mouth perfection. And the choices don't stop there; the options are truly endless!

My favorite hotpot spot!! Their ingredients are fresh & 'clean' tasting, not like the typical greasy broths that comes with most hotpot. They are definitely a lot more expensive than the other AYCE hotpot restaurants but if you don't want to feel gross after, this is the place to go.

AYCE hot pot from 9 pm to midnight! The broths are all really flavorful and they have a huge selection of meats and veggies. I also love a hot pot with a sauce bar and the sauce bar here is very extensive! They also have some extra appetizers like edamame, fruit jellies, drinks, and peanuts for you to munch on while waiting for your broth to boil. Our server was super accommodating and I loved the bonus sweet treat that was included with the AYCE. Would recommend making a reservation via yelp in advance.

The store manager named Ze gave us very uncomfortable dinning experience tonight. We asked for water and food twice until they served them. Ze has the most indifferent attitude among all the waiters, shocked that he is the store manager. In the end, he forced us to finished everything in the broth, even though we told Ze it's very salty and not healthy at all. We will never visit this place again because of Ze, and will let our friends and family know about what happened to us.

Genuinely high quality meats, services, and broth flavors. The all you can eat deal is the best value of course, especially if you have an appetite for meat, but the vegetables are incredibly fresh as well. The service is snappy and immediate, with new plates coming pretty quickly after being ordered. The broth is by far the most amazing thing about this hotpot place--flavorful, lightly creamy, absolutely mouthwatering, and seasons any raw food thoroughly enough that it's one of the few hotpot places I visit where I don't even need sauce. And if you DO love sauce, they also have you covered--if they ask to "make the sauce for you" you should ABSOLUTELY try it out. Their house blend sauce brings out the richness and aroma from the broth while giving an umami texture that makes any meats, particularly thinner slices, melt in your mouth. You won't be able to stop eating once you start.

If you somehow manage to get through the meal itself without getting too full for dessert, they have a fantastic selection of jellies, toppings, fruits, and assortment of fresh and delectable sweets at a dessert bar that I tend to make multiple trips back to. And if you still somehow have room in your stomach after dessert too... they actually give a free vanilla ice cream cone with your bill at the end. The meal is likely pricier than other hotpot places, but worthwhile for the ingredient freshness, broth quality, and fast service.

Note: I do not recommend this place if you are on a diet because personally any semblance of self control vanished the second the broth came out. I can still imagine the rich aroma even now, three months after I've last visited...

The dolar shop was as good as i expected! their soups were very savory and their produce was super fresh. 

We opted for the meat platter which has 2 different type of beef and lamb. That tasted great, along with our addition of noodles, veggies, etc. 

The service was also super nice and attentive. I accidentally dropped my chopsticks twice but they were so patient with bringing me new ones :,). 

My only call out is if you would like an "AYCE" experience, come after 9pm!
High quality hotpot & efficient service, complimentary ice cream at the end is delicious as well!

Friendly staff and fast service. Prices weren't exactly the cheapest for a hot pot place but everything tasted fresh. We selected set menu items and were pretty satisfied and full with what we got. the downside was that all ordering was made with a tablet which didn't fully translate the menu selection over to English so when trying to figure out what was in a set, it was fully in Chinese.

I really liked this place.  Even though the AYCE places makes it easier, this place I don't over indulge.  

The meats were tender and fresh.  All the sides were good.  The servers were quick and friendly.  

I liked that everyone had their own hot pot.  It's like any other hot pot place but this place was clean and the furniture was not sticky.
Been here a bunch of times, and it's our favorite hot pot in Manhattan. The ingredients are high quality and the seating is comfortable. Good for group dinners.

The staffs were friendly, made a reservation. You order your selection via their tablet. This is more on the pricer side for hot pot. These are individual pots on the electric stove top. You can make the sauce in the back of the store or they have their house sauces. We ordered two sets and had ice cream cone at the end. Scan the QR code on the receipt to take their survey to have the credit card fee taken off your receipt. Would recommend coming here!  

Food: 5/5
Service: 5/5
Ambience: 5/5

While more on the pricey side, Dolar Shop was definitely one of the best hot pot places I've had. You are paying for the high quality broth and meats. We both got the signature pork bone broth, which came with chicken and pork tripe. It was so savory and delicious. I've never had another place where I could not stop drinking the broth the whole time, even when I was full. The different cuts of beef and pork belly we got were also extremely tender and had the perfect amount of fat.  Other highlights include the kimchi side and soft serve at the end of the meal. 

The only downside of the meal was that we weren't informed the still water would cost $8. Kind of excessive and I would never spend that much for water otherwise.

Exceeded my expectations.

We arrived on a Monday night and got seated right away.

The meat quality blew me. The creamy pork broth was delicious. And the abundance of options deserves recognition. They have a happy hour starting at 9pm for ayce for $49 for those of you that enjoy the stuffing.

My only critique is the water. Before pouring the sparkling water or still water, it'd be great to know that the bottles cost $8. Tap water does the trick and it was an unpleasant surprise upon check out. 

Good meal, would come again, but imma pack my own h20

The food is always good there but the service can be infuriating. We've gone on and off for years and I think the last time will really be our last time. They make people wait for no reason even if your full party is there. We arrived early for our reservation and were told we needed to wait for 15 mins despite full party there and they had many empty tables.

I love the Dolar shop.  I visit the manhattan location which is not all you can eat until after 9 but the quality of the food is worth it.  They offer wagyu meats but also have less expensive cuts that are still fatty and delicious.  The house made noodles are chewy and fresh and they offer a full sweet  bar that has fruit, popping jellies and boba along with the sauce bar, all included with your meal.  Fantastic option for hot pot!

Hot pot is one of my favorite meals so I was very intrigued by The Dolar Shop when I arrived at my hotel next door. I went for dinner with colleagues and loved it. If this is your first time having hot pot, this place might be a little confusing. There wasn't any instruction and everything was ordered via an iPad on the table. 

Food: I loved the crispy pork appetizer, it was amazing. I recommend the split broth option with creamy and spicy broth. You get the best of both worlds and can try a little of everything. If it's your first time, get one of the setups! It's got meats, veggies, sides, broth, etc. Don't forget the free ice cream at the end! 

Drinks: They don't have a ton of options. It's primarily just beer and wine.

Ambiance: It's a very sleek restaurant with plenty of seating. I would definitely go back if I were visiting NYC again.

~ Lunch Set (Flat Iron cut) $26.99 ~
You can pick 2 soup base, my to go is the spicy and creamy pork broth. The pork broth even come with a separate plate of chicken and pork tripe 

The value of this lunch set is unparalleled!! You get a large plate of sliced meat, assorted vegetables, spam, quail eggs, shrimp paste, and unlimited noodle! There is also a self serve table where you get all you can eat side dishes like kimchi, spicy seaweed, pickled edamame, bean curd, and desserts! My favourite is the osmanthus jelly! You can add various toppings e.g. mini taro balls, fruit pulps, and fresh fruits!! Then you finish off with a complimentary vanilla soft serve.

- - - - - -

Will I be back? YES
They do the lunch menu even during weekend, from 12 to 5pm! You get so many food for the price, I'm super stuffed every single time! Def will come back again and again when i crave for hotpot, esp since we eat them all year round even in summer
They have amazing soup base for their hot pot. The waiter was great in explaining the whole process of how to order during lunch since it's not AYCE

My fave hotpot place in New York! The soup bases aren't extraordinary but the meat tho 
The meat is definitely higher quality compared to other hotpot spots and their shrimp pate is just the best!

My favorite hot pot in Manhattan!!! 

The Dolar Shop has never let me down with its top quality ingredients, amazing service, and unlimited DIY sauce & dessert bar (the newly upgraded Market Table is AMAZING). Depending on when you visit, you can either order a la carte, seasonal set menus, or AYCE. The seasonal set menus are great and include more than enough for a single person. 

When you start the meal, the staff will offer to mix you a special dipping sauce - don't miss out on this because it is SO good. My must order items from the menu are the Chef's Creamy Pork Broth, Selected Beef & Lamb Platter, the Dolar Shop Shrimp Pate, and Hand-Crafted Noodles. Overall service and vibes are fantastic and ideal for a large group. Don't forget to leave room for the desserts at the Market Table and the complimentary soft serve at the end of the meal!

I enjoyed having hotpot here. The meat quality is good and delicious. The buffet bar selection is a bit small compared to other places I've been to. I like the dessert bar. The price is slightly pricier than other places for AYCE but I think the quality is worth it. Overall, I enjoyed the food. 

The service was adequate but not above and beyond. I noticed that plastic bib like coverings are only given when asked. The waiter never once told us that it is available to us. 

The furniture is starting to look a bit worn out.
the food here is expensive but really good! i always over order. the mushroom base is incredible

It was my first time having hotpot in New York, it was also my friend's first time trying hotpot and so considering the weather back in the beginning of May be somewhat warm and then cold this was perfect. The service was really on par with refilling our waters and asking if we needed anything else. Also I didn't know this place offered free ice cream afterwords which was a sweet bonus till the very end. Enjoyed my food here and will happily do another hot pot here again.
Amazing service, quality ingredients, and space is cool and modern. Can get expensive if you order a la carte - would definitely recommend their lunch special which is the best value for money!

Market table (20pp) is a great deal.  Fiancé and I stuffed ourselves with loads of fish balls, chicken slices, noodles, and vegetables etc, dipped in the make-your-own sauces.  The market table includes a dessert bar, and you can ask for complimentary ice cream as well.  The restaurant itself is clean and spacious.
One of my favorite hot pot places! Delicious quality meat and service is great - also the atmosphere is great for celebrations!
Excellent service and food. My favorite hotpot place in NYC. Bring your friends and family here. You won't disappoint them.

Came for a quasi-celebratory dinner with friends - we had reservations and waited a few minutes after arriving to get seated (it was really busy for a weekday evening). I haven't been to the Dolar Shop in a while, and I used to think that it was pretty good but really expensive - seems that this has only gotten more pronounced in the meantime lol.

I ordered the combination broth with pork bone and mala, and both were quite yummy. The pork bone broth is very fragrant and definitely a solid, lighter complement to the spicy mala, although it is always a bit strange to me that the Dolar Shop always gives some chicken (or tripe) with the pork broth.

For meats, we really liked the premier cru beef thick cut plate, and the boneless beef option was very yummy, too (both are some type of your typical hot pot fatty beef).

The flounder fillet was very delicious (portion size larger than expected), so def a recommendation if you like fish. Veggies were a little more disappointing - the cabbage we ordered was small (in portion) and consisted mostly of the cabbage stems :( Also, I wish they had potato slices instead of their 8-second shredded potato.

The desserts selection next to the sauce bar was surprisingly tasty - I really liked the dragonfruit and green jelly options, as well as the classic orange slices, for a sweet reprieve after a heavy hotpot meal haha. Also I always love the ice cream at the end

All in all, we were quite full, and certainly it was a very delicious meal, but I'm not really sure if the high price was worth it, given the amount and the quality of the food. I think you can't go wrong with most of the meat options, but they all cost significantly more than I would expect, and most of the veggies/fishballs/seafood/etc. don't really seem to be worth the price. I took a look at some of the sets, and I think those might be better value if you were to come for e.g. lunch.

Sigh but hot pot is also just quite expensive nowadays I suppose, perhaps I should re-calibrate my expectations haha

Rating: 3.5 stars 

My friend and I stopped by on a Friday night at 8:30 PM and the restaurant was completely packed. I thankfully had made a reservation so we were seated a couple of minutes after we arrived in a comfortable side booth for two. 

Service was fast and our server was super nice. You order everything on the iPad but the total of everything was quite hefty especially for the amount of food you get. 

For my broth, I got the creamy pork broth and tomato broth. The tomato broth was disappointing since it was super watered down. However, the pork broth was so delicious, I would recommend just getting the pork broth next time. 

For meats we only ordered a ribeye. The quality of the ribeye we got was so good. It was shaved so thinly that it cooked in only a few seconds and was perfect. We got other items as well like veggies and meat/fish balls which were all very tasty but pretty much like all other hot pot places in the city. 

I did really like their sauce and dessert station. There was a great selection of sauce choices. And the tiny cut fruit, fermented sweet rice and popping jelly were such a great end to a meal. The main issue I had though was that the floor of the restaurant especially around the sauce area was super sticky and gross. I'm sure it is hard to clean with so many customers around but would be nice to be more mindful of it.

All in all, a nice hot pot location but not sure if the hefty price tag is fully worth it.

I have eaten at many hotpot places but this was one of the best. 

The service makes you feel like a very important guest and the interior of the restaurant feels cool and modern. 

As others have mentioned, this place can get quite expensive. However, I feel they are overlooking the fantastic deal available with the individual "sets" available. When selecting a set, the fee for the broth is included, as well as the fee for using the "sauce bar" and you get a pretty large quantity of food. I dined with two other people and we each ordered our own set plus an additional plate of lamb, frozen tofu and some fresh bamboo shoots a la cart. We were stuffed by the end and the total came out to around $50 a person. If you're attempting to eat here on a budget, the sets are definitely the way to go. 

I initially found it sort of silly that you need to pay per person to use the sauce bar here if you don't get a pre set meal, but the sauce bar is really so much more than that. It's a long table with fresh fruit and snacks and cold salads in addition to the sauces and you definitely could fill up on stuff from here if you found your pre set meal didn't include enough food. However, the plate of meat they give you per person is quite large. 

The hallmark of a good hot pot spot for me, is whether or not the broth is able to sufficiently season your food. Some cheaper places leave you leaning on your sauce to season every bite, but here, it's possible to enjoy without covering everything in sauce. 

We ordered a plate of bamboo shoots in addition to our sets and I have never had fresh bamboo like this before. It was so delicious, like a subtly sweet tender asparagus. The meat was all tender and high quality and the vegetable plate seemed well portioned for one person. It also included some shrimp paste which I've never tried before. When cooked it created a beautiful bouncy shrimp ball which I really enjoyed. 

I had a great time here and will definitely come back as I am intrigued by the all you can eat deal they begin offering late night. The soft serve ice cream cone they offer you at the end is just the icing on the cake!

Probably one of my favorite hotpot places. You get your own bowl and you can choose from high quality ingredients. The service is also pretty phenomenal. The pork bone broth was probably one of my favorites and so was the dessert bar !

Other than being a bit expensive at the quality level the experience was great. My partner and I ordered the set menu with a few extra types of beef afterwards both choosing the spicy broth. The portions were okay, in terms of taste:price the premier cru beef was the best imo. The restaurant definitely had a wait but it wasn't as bad as it could be (7pm for 2 was around 45min) and the atmosphere was intimate, saw a few dates and a couple groups of families/friends, overall the ambiance isn't something that detracts. Service was great though, waiters had really helpful suggestions and definitely helped us pick the best pieces we had that night.

The meat and produce quality here and the flavors of the broths and sauces are top-notch by Manhattan standards. The service unfortunately can be hit-or-miss.

I've come here both for their a la carte menu and their more recent post-9pm AYCE offering. We came recently at for a 9pm reservation but were unfortunately not seated until almost 9:30 and couldn't flag down a waiter to take our order until 9:45.

The meal itself was fantastic. Dolar Shop offers USDA Prime beef cuts and New Zealand lamb and it's all absolutely delicious. The veggie and mushroom options are also plentiful and I love the dessert options too (youtiao, maqiu, bingfen bar).

Near the end of the meal, things started to fall apart a bit. The steam from the hotpot started to condense on the ceiling and drip back down onto us (hadn't experienced this before so I assume it only happens at certain tables). The staff also tried to charge us for leftover AYCE ingredients even though we had ordered quite accurately for our large party of 7 people and only left behind 5% of what we ordered (mostly veggies and noodles). We explained this to the waitress along with the fact we had been seated and had our order taken late so it was hard to keep eating past 11:30pm. She agreed to remove the charge, but apparently they don't communicate internally because a different waiter then came and charged us again and we had to have the same convo again.

Will still probably come back because it's top-tier in-demand hotpot in the city, but don't ever expect amazing service for the same reason.

Delicious - one of the best hot pots l've had. The soup was tasty and flavorful (I got combo Sichuan and tomato). The meat (especially the wagyu) was super tender and practically melts in your mouth. The sides were also a good size, enough to split amongst 4 people. Though, with more people, we had to order double of some items. I liked the seaweed knots and fresh bean curd skins, which come as knots.

Sauce bar is insane - all the normal sauces (including a beef sauce with ground beef) but it also had appetizers, like peanuts, spicy seaweed strings and bean curd strings. There were also fruit and a dessert section, with things like lychee jelly, syrups, and ice jelly and taro balls. At the end, they give you an ice cream cone that's so milky and delicious. Since it's not AYCE before 9, it does add up though so be careful.

Came here at 10pm on a Sunday. Reservation was not required, but we had to sign in which seems to be the same as reserving on yelp.

We were seated rather quickly as they weren't very busy. They currently have a deal which is everyday after 9pm, the price is $19.99 for ayce (not including meat or seafood). Meat and seafood is an additional $5 per plate. They also have a beverage aycd which includes plum juice, soy milk, and milk tea.

Everyone gets their own hotpot, which you can choose up to 2 broths.

They have a good selection of vegetables, fish balls (reg, with roe, with egg yolk), tofu (skin), etc. They have some carbs such as mantou with condensed milk, etc. There is also cold rice dessert (bing fan). Lastly, they have ice cream which you can choose between yogurt vanilla or matcha. (I personally like the matcha more)

I personally really like fish ball with roe, and finding good ones are hard. This place has great fish ball with roe. The cold rice dessert was okay/good. You can choose what to include as you are making it yourself. They have dragon fruit, mango, popping boba, orange, red bean, sweet potato/taro ball. The sweet potato and taro ball aren't very fresh which is why I said it was okay. Everything else is typical in term of food. I got the unlimited beverage (not everyone on your table needs to get it). The plum juice is good, but Ive never had plum juice previously so idk what to compare it to. The soy milk is good.

The service was alright. It takes a but of effort to get a waiters attention. They also ran out of some food which they didnt refill (might be bc they were closing). My group did ask them which they then refilled.

This is great for eating with friends but also having your own individual food. A great place to chat with friends while you eat!
My favorite hot pot place! The mushroom broth is a must. They have great quality veggies and meat, and love the little ice cream treat at the end!

*Dare I say this is my favorite hot pot place that I've ever tried in the US? It just might be...*

This was a highly recommended place, so we stopped by on a cold, windy, overcast day a little after opening on a Sunday and were seated immediately in the back near the sauce and dessert bar. They offered a ton of side dishes as well which was already included in the price of your meal. 

Their menu was on an iPad where you could order all of your dishes a la cart in addition to appetizers and drinks. I was recovering from food poisoning unfortunately, so I decided to get their Chef's Creamy Pork Broth with chicken. It was probably the most delicious hot pot base I have ever tried, so good that you could drink it all on it's own. Also ordered a variety of meats, but the standout was definitely the hand cut prime short rib (the circle meats). It was so incredibly tender and tasted amazing on it's own without any sauce. All our other dishes like tofus and veggies were really great quality and portions were honestly decent for the price. 

The restaurant itself was nice and clean, pretty airy and spacious for the size. Our waiter was very attentive and always refilled our water or topped off our broth because we were drinking it like soup. At the end, he brought over some ice cream which also tasted really good. 

I only have good things to say about our experience and would hands down go back a few times the next time I'm back in the city.
probably the best hot pot in manhattan, don't have to go to flushing for good hot pot now

Overall, I love the cleanliness and modernity of this space, though I think from a price perspective, the value for your dollar is debatable (however, given the neighborhood, the pricing also makes more sense).

From the individual pots to the brilliant "Market Table" concept, I felt like Dolar Shop was a nice, slightly elevated hot pot experience in the city. Could I get similar food at a lower price point? 100% But did I have fun with my group even with the slightly pricier items? Absolutely. The staff were also very attentive and kind (though it probably helps to be a Mandarin speaker as we interacted with the staff mostly this way) and overall I'd definitely return if I'm in the area and with a group.

Excellent service! There was a vegan tomato broth for the allergy sensitive folks or anyone really out there and you get your own individual hotpot much like your own bowl which makes me feel really happy. Absolutely fell in love with the all-you-care to eat dessert station - I love me some fermented rice with cube-cut fruits and taro balls. There were a lot of popping balls that my friend really liked too. Really cozy ambiance - felt the warmth from the bustling music and people who were just happy to be with their pals on a Saturday - everyone's space felt like their own yet also part of the larger family

For now, Dolar Shop is the best hot pot in Manhattan. The experience is exactly what you would get in China, and the flavors are as well. They have many bases to choose from, the sauces are great, and they have so so many dishes you can order. The portions are on the smaller side, and therefore this place gets pretty pricey pretty quickly...I would allocate around $80 a person after tip and tax. 

The drink menu is also pretty affordable, which is a big plus. You don't have to break your back just to have some booze. If you're into sake, the Kubota half bottle is a really good deal.
so fun , employees are extremely respectful & welcoming , foods great & they were genuinely just an overall good vibe & cheap , 10/10 recommended

This might be one of my favorite hot pot places ever.

I love Hot Pot, and I was honestly very skeptical of trying this place.
We went for my friend's birthday by our other friend's suggestion and I did not think they would be so good.

This restaurant is a la cart, but every penny was worth it.
We all got our own personal hot pots so that was really neat; they also provided us with bibs as well. 

I loved the oysters the most, even though it was pricey, we all thought it was really good. Although everything tasted really good, I would not recommend the wagyu. Not that it didn't taste good, but it was hard to cook since it was shaped like a cube. 

At the end of the meal, they give you complimentary ice cream! Since it was my friend's birthday, they provided us with 2 additional ice cream cones so that was very nice of them. For the 7 of us, we received 9 ice cream cones.
The sweet vanilla cone balances the spicy broth and makes it all worth it.

I would definitely recommend Dolar Shop if you're ever in the NYC area!

Such a luxurious hotpot experience! I tried their specialty - the creamy chicken and pork tripe soup - and it was the first time I've been to a hot pot shop where they gave a platter of chicken and pork tripe to go with the soup. Additionally, you can tell that when they refill the pot, they refill it with real creamy broth instead of the watery substance you see at other places. Tip: if you have a lot of soup leftover, ask to take it to go so you have an additional meal the next day. 

They have the standard seafood, meats and vegetables as any other hotpot area but what makes them really stand out is the freshness of their produce. You can tell that they make an effort to pick out high quality products. Even the chicken - which typically gets super tough and hard after being in the broth for a while - was really tender because I think they use chicken thighs. I also recommend getting the seafood too, something I don't typically get at other hot pot restaurants since it's overpriced and doesn't taste good. 

At the end, you get a cone of ice cream which feels really good in your tummy after all the salty and hot foods. 

If you pay in cash, you'll also get a discount too!

Bring my friend to this place in the cold weather, the service and food quality still very good. You can make your own hot pot sauce or they can do it for you. Highly recommend the banana pancake, good with the ice cream. Btw, love the tomato soup!

Good hotpot. The food is great. The only thing I don't like is this place is not for solo eater. I was told to wait for an hour. I know that it's hard to estimate the time, but I was not seated until 1 hour and 50 mins later. Usually I wouldn't say anything because I was willing to wait. But as I kept checking the waitlist, I realized that my position was being pushed down at least twice, for bigger party. Will not go back.
Great selection of fruit, service, and seating. The best deal is all you can eat after nine PM

Gf loves hotpot. Friends recommended them. We came. 

And left wayyyy too full - thank you dolar shop for feeding our gluttony :) 

Love the self serve sauce, fruit and dessert bar. Meat quality was good but not mind blowing. Overall pretty great but not mind blowing

This used to be our favorite hot pot spot even though it was a bit pricey. Unfortunately, the prices have increased even more so the value is just not there. I do like the ability to have combination broth.

I was invited to a birthday celebration at The Dolar Shop, and discovered that it is a great restaurant for Chinese Hotpot.  Unlike other such establishments, each person gets their own hotpot, allowing for a variety of broth choices.  There is a very extensive menu of ingredients to add to your hotpot.  I enjoyed the mushroom broth with black truffle which paired well with meats, vegetables, and seafood options.  Our group ordered noodles, beef, lamb, shrimp, scallops and a three tiered tray of vegetables, all of which were perfectly prepped and fresh.  There is also a bar of condiments and salads to accompany the meal.  For those with food allergies, the tomato vegetable broth is free of dairy and gluten.  Mung bean noodles are also available.   A birthday "scratch off" card was offered to the birthday girl which gifted her a free item.   I would definitely recommend this restaurant for groups and special occasions!

What a gorgeous, amazing-vibe hotpot spot in the city! Absolutely love how you order off the iPad whatever you want, make your own sauce, and enjoy the food. The wagyu short rib is a must, and idk why but I'm obsseased with the roe balls! Order meats, seafood, veggies, whatever you want! Super easy, convenient and great for dining!

Great food great service great ambiance. 

There's not an overwhelming list of menu items. Some combination platters that include a veggie platter and a soup base. Then plenty of a la carte choices of soup bases and platters. 

We were a party of 6, ordered 2 combos: lamb and short ribs which came with 2 veggie platters and two soup bases. Then we added two a la carte soup bases and additional platters of noodles, scallops, fish and steak. 

The market buffet table had spices, sauces and other additions like kimchi, peanuts, scallions and cilantro. Dessert is jello types and popping bobas with some fixings. 

We found what we ordered was just the right amount of variety and quantity for us. With the market table there was plenty to taste and eat. We finished most of it and brought home extra soup base.

Overall, So nourishing and comforting for winter!  Can't wait to return.

I went here around 5pm on a Friday evening with my close friends. It wasn't crowded at all. Two of us ordered the mild spicy pork broth. After discovering how full of oil and chilies  were in the broth, I asked if I can change my broth because it was WAY TOO SPICY, the kind of Szechwan spice that burned your lips and made tasting the food impossible. One server said he couldn't return the broth and said he'll just scoop all the chilies in the broth out of it. He scooped about 2 cups full of hot chilies out of mine and my friends broth, and even then it was still unbearable. We resorted to just trying to share with my friend's pot who ordered clear pork broth. Even way into our meal where we barely ate anything because of the spice level, another server came to remove yet more oil and chilies from the broth. At that point he could have just given us a new pot of broth so we could have enjoyed our meal but he didn't. On top of this all, since we sat down before 5pm we were "eligible" for "lunch prices" but make sure you actually have to pay before 5pm, even if you're in the middle of a meal or convo with your friends because that was another pet peeve (someone came over and interrupted us to made sure we paid before 5pm)... not the kind of hot pot place we had in mind.
Good food, friendly service. And it's one of the most decent hotpot spots in Manhattan

Ok I think I actually have a problem because I'm addicted to this place and I can't stop thinking about it. The AYCE after 9PM is such a good deal ($45 I think) - even though they are out of some of the items at night, it's still so worth it. I've gotten into a few arguments with my boyfriend recently because this place is the only place I want to go out to eat at and I think that relationships are all about compromise so he should let us eat there every meal - RIGHT? Jk jk but I do defend this place with my life for no reason - you would think I have stake in their stock or something with how much I try to rally everyone to go. 

If you haven't been to this hot pot yet - go. It will change your life. (I like to order the chicken/pork soup and the mala soup. My favorite items to order are: watermelon juice, shrimp pate, mung bean noodles, enoki mushrooms, handcrafted noodles, tong ho, napa cabbage. Ugh. I am getting hungry again.)

Surprised to find geoduck in this place, $55/lb. Service was good. Nice to have a self serve appetizer bar and dessert bar. You have to ask for ice cream cones at the end. Overall, the service is good and attentive. Would come again.
Love the sauce bar and quality of ingredients here. This is a bar above hai di lao for hot pot.
Im not a fan of hot pot and i loooove this place. Best hot pot fatty beef!! Geoduck was amazing. The free ice cream at the end was a nice touch.

The service is OK, there is a 45.99 1 hour and 45 minutes all-you-can-eat activity at 9-12 o'clock in the evening, but there are not many dishes to choose from, 55, and there can be no leftovers. The remaining food is fined 9.9 dollars per 100 grams.

food was excellent, meat quality was there

service was good except for some moments where it was a little difficult to get our waiter's attention

spicy broth was real spicy so if u can't handle it, you should not order it otherwise you'll be drinking a lot of water during ur meal.

free vanilla cone at the end

The cleanest hot pot shop I've found in Manhattan and reminds me of the Flushing places. Great selection of free snacks and sauces, and the iPad makes ordering hot pot ingredients a breeze. The place is massive and good for groups as well. The meat quality was good and they give you good portions for the price, which is a little higher than some places around town but overall still a good deal especially if you come with more than 2 people.

Great spot in St Marks area. They give you a tablet for ease of ordering. Everyone gets their own pot with a great selection of soups. I love the sauce station. When you pay, you get an ice cream cone.

0.75/1 Ambience; 1.75/2 Food; 0.5/1 Service; 0.5/1 Value

My friend and I were looking to grab dinner when we spontaneously walked by Dollar Shop and were enamored by the aroma emanating from the restaurant. It smelled so rich and delicious we went in and the staff was able to accommodate us as walk-ins after a short wait. The restaurant is very large and since we were seated towards the back, it felt very spacious. However, it was super loud and I struggled to hear my friend across the table even. 

Note that the option for vegan/vegetarian/non-pork eater-friendly broth is limited to the truffle black mushroom broth only, as all others are pork-based. I opted for this broth, and shared proteins and veggies with my friend who got the spicy pork and chicken and pork based broths. The truffle mushroom comes with freshly shaved slices of truffle, and is super savory and warm with a rich umami flavor. We got two cuts of beef, lamb, chicken, soft tofu, enoki mushrooms and lettuce. Everything was fresh, the food tasted great, and the cuts of meat were high quality. 

Overall, Dollar Shop was a great experience, but the portions are rather small for the price. Between the two of us, it amounted to $80 before tax, and we were still quite hungry. There are certainly more affordable and comparable hot spots in the city. Another point was that while the service was overall fine, it felt quite rushed as if they wanted us out really soon. They recommended a sauce to us, but never told us there was the option to make our own at the bar (we found it as we were walking out), and we were never offered the free ice cream either, which is apparently common according to other Yelp reviews :(

A good quality hotpot place in East Village. I got the beef set that comes with beef slices, vegetables, and other items. It is a good amount of food. They also have a la carte option. Each person gets individual pot and can select different broths. Great for going with friends that don't want to share a big pot like traditional hotpot places. Although the quality and service are great here, I think there are many comparable options that have more varieties. Still a great spot to eat in Manhattan! They also have a flushing location that have yet to try.

TLDR: This is my new go-to for hot pot, and a great place to bring friends visiting from places without many hot pot options! 

I booked a reservation ahead-of-time on Yelp. Definitely recommend doing this, as the place was bumpin'! They texted me a minute or two after my reservation time that I needed to check in within 5 minutes to secure my spot. Done! I waited for the rest of my party to show up, and we were promptly seated.

The ambiance was lively, a little loud but not so loud that we couldn't hear each other, since the booth-style tables have barriers between each other. It was bright lighting, but it still felt very nice. Servers helped explain the menu and refill waters and broth, but otherwise you're ordering on an iPad.

The food itself was great! I love that they do individual hot pots, my group got a variety of the broths, and everyone was happy! I loooved my mushroom broth. Also to note, we got the cheapest beef option ‍ but it was soooo good!! Preferred that over the pork belly which was just mediocre IMHO. All the veggies were fresh, and the pancakes were great! Icing on the cake was the free ice cream at the end
Very good food. Service was good too. Loved the free fruits that we were able to get. The combos had a lot of sides but since I'm a picky POS I wish I had ordered just straight meat instead.
Super clean, high quality meats and who doesn't love a meal that ends in free ice cream. A bit pricier than other hot pots in the city but well worth it in my opinion

I really liked the food quality of everything here, but I think the food was a little overpriced. The service was great. I did have trouble making a reservation because of a language barrier with one of the workers, but it turned out fine.

Food quality and variety is always great. I like that they have individual pots and many side dishes. The only downside is the wait during dinner time and it's relatively more expensive than other venues. However I think it's worth the price.
This place is insanely busy - make a reservation for sure! With that said, food is delicious. We usually end up around $50 a person.

Service: 5/5 super friendly/ attentive 
Food: 4.5/5 - pretty good quality esp compared to other hot pot places in nyc 
Price: 3/5 - I'm not sure it's worth 70 dollars per person even though we didn't even get drinks

This manhattan spot is definitely swankier and fancier than it's sister location in Flushing. With that being said, you'll be drawn to one or the other bases on your needs!

Meat quality here is great. All ones recommended by our server were delicious, impeccable, and succulent! The vegetables and what not were lacking in affordability, which didn't suit my taste.

They have a signature dipping sauce they can make you upon request that is soooooo tasty and goes with everything. I generally like to think I know what I like with hotpot, but the sauce was a pleasant surprise from what I usually make for myself. :)

Service itself is marvelous! Super friendly from hosts to managers. They take care of all your needs graciously without being overbearing. 

Presentation is top tier. Everything is wonderfully decorated and particularly curated. The whole dinner I had was well executed.

It's more bougie than I would like for a $180/3 people. But for a going out dinner it may be worth it!
